listed_quote.quote: Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (NYSE: TTP), Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NYSE: NDP),

announcement.quote: Tortoise announced today that following a strategic review of the funds, the Board of Directors has approved a proposal to merge Tortoise Energy Independence Fund, Inc. (NDP) with and into Tortoise Pipeline & Energy Fund, Inc. (TTP).

deals.notes: The special meeting for the merger was scheduled for April 7, 2021, then adjourned to June 4, 2021 (0001140361-21-011832, 2021-04-06) with the statement that a majority of shares voted so far supported the merger. No excerpt states the final result. The 2021-05-25 and 2022 proxies are annual-meeting materials that still list NDP and TTP as separate registrants, but the excerpts do not say whether the merger was completed or abandoned, so the outcome is left null.

problems: Outcome of the NDP into TTP merger is not stated in any excerpt; the later DEF 14A/DEFA14A filings (0001398344-21-011958, 0001398344-22-012421, 0001140361-22-028357) are annual-meeting materials (directors, auditor) and do not discuss the merger in the excerpts.
